description: Machine-readable provenance record for every input file consumed by any Rosetta demo path. Regenerate and validate with: python scripts/validate_manifest.py --regen / --check

files.description: SQLite database used by the healthcare demo path. The developer commit message (ab334aaa) describes this as 'the real DataHub healthcare sample dataset (datasets/healthcare/healthcare.db — 55,500 synthetic patient records)'. Rosetta opens this file read-only and never writes to it.
files.source_dataset: DataHub sample data supplied through the official Build with DataHub Agent Hackathon resources
files.source_url_note: URL referenced in rosetta/healthcare_source.py FileNotFoundError message and confirmed by developer commit message ab334aaa.
files.license: Not established — no LICENSE file was bundled with the dataset
files.git_commit_message: feat: live healthcare data source from DataHub hackathon sample
files.transformations_applied: None. All queries are read-only SELECT statements. No INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL is executed.
rosetta_constructed_on_top: 10 MetricDefinition objects (5 metrics × 2 teams each) in rosetta/healthcare_source.py
DataHub URN lineage graph (_DOWNSTREAM dict in rosetta/healthcare_source.py)
